product.name: SongChart
product.summary: Music discovery, canonical metadata, provenance, provider evidence and legal listening or viewing destinations.

roadmap.rule: roadmap expresses direction; stage-plan activates exactly one stage; candidate stages are not execution authority

journeys.goal: Find canonical music entities and navigate trustworthy public detail pages.
gaps: Make relationship/credit semantics explicit enough for read models without provider-specific branching.
Make destination/media evidence explicitly projectable from canonical entities without becoming canonical identity.

journeys.goal: Move from a canonical SongChart entity to an approved listening/watching destination while retaining canonical context.
gaps: Define a canonical read contract for provider destinations and media evidence.
Keep destination availability/provider identifiers outside canonical primary identity.

journeys.goal: Manage account identity and security without coupling account data to provider identities.

new_developer.goal: Understand the system enough to navigate and make a bounded change without reading the entire repository.

ai.goal: Resolve semantic owners, existing capabilities, gaps, relations and verification before editing; never infer ownership from filenames alone.

product_owner.goal: See capabilities, completeness, decision debt and roadmap without implementation noise.

end_user.goal: Understand available product capabilities and how to use them without exposing internal architecture vocabulary.

navigation_rule: Resolve semantic journey/use-case/capability IDs and mapping state before searching implementation names. Existing route surface does not imply mapped application ownership.
